title: Rename Window Command To Action
description: In ui, os, and playground: rename the concept of "command" (as used for window kinds — actions and tools bound to a window) to "action". Every window kind can have actions; actions and tools are bound to windows. "Command" is being reserved for a different concept, so all naming referring to window commands must become "action" naming — types, functions, variables, props, file names, docs, comments — with no legacy aliases or backwards-compatible re-exports left behind.
summary:
Renamed the window/tool "action-dispatch protocol" from Command* naming to Action* naming across ui, os, and the sketchpad ("playground") app, plus every other consumer of the shared framework-core protocol repo-wide, so no legacy "Command" naming remains for this concept. Key renames: CommandDescriptor→ActionDescriptor, CommandBus→ActionBus, CommandContext/Invocation/Result/Definition/Kind/Id→Action*, onCommand→onAction, hoverCommand/unhoverCommand/dropCommand→hoverAction/unhoverAction/dropAction, handle_command_patch_ops→handle_action_patch_ops (and every one of its ~24 plugin-crate implementations), the WIT interface's handle-command/invoke-command→handle-action/invoke-action (with regenerated Rust bindings updated), the Engagement input's "Command"→"Action" copy and identifiers in ui/js/react/index.tsx, and AppDefinition.commands→.actions on both the JS and Rust sides. Deliberately left untouched (a different, unrelated "command" concept per the task): the cmdk-based Command-palette UI primitives (Command, CommandDialog, CommandInput, etc.), VCS/domain-command-sourcing types (DocumentVcsCommand, compose's CommandEnvelope/DomainCommand/ComposeCommand hub actor protocol), wgpu's CommandEncoder (GPU API), fsm's Command<M>/CommandSink state-machine effect queue, and the top-level script.ts CLI "command router" convention.

Verification: full `cargo check --workspace` passes with zero errors; framework-renderer-react test suite 74/75 pass (the one failure is a pre-existing, unrelated Bun dynamic-import quirk confirmed present before this change via git history); framework-renderer-wgpu tests 2/2 pass. A repo-wide case-insensitive grep for "command" was run repeatedly to hunt down every real consumer of the renamed protocol (found and fixed follow-on breakage in framework/plugin/rs/component.rs, framework/plugin/host/rs/lib.rs, framework/wit/world.wit, framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs, infinite/world/rs/lib.rs, coda/client/ui/desktop/js/renderer.tsx, cad/renderer/js/index.tsx, and .storybook stories) beyond the files literally under ui/os/playground, since the shared protocol's public API changed and every consumer had to follow or the workspace wouldn't build.

Flagged but explicitly NOT fixed (pre-existing, unrelated to this rename): coda/client/ui/desktop/js/renderer.tsx and compose/client/lib/sketchpad/js/{index.ts,boot.tsx} import from `@semio-tech/framework-platform-core` and `@semio-tech/framework-platform-renderer-react`, packages/paths that do not exist anywhere in the repo (only `framework/product/os/core` exists) — a broken import predating this task, out of scope for a naming rename.
